scope: Every inventoried shape-owned inherited geometry, identity/XML ownership, sequence order and connector endpoint member relevant to selection operations; underscore-prefixed public records are included.

languageSecurityMapping.names: Neutral model snake_case member names remain primary; operation JSON is camelCase.
languageSecurityMapping.arguments: Source positional defaults remain positional optional arguments; keyword-only arguments use a trailing typed object. undefined selects defaults; null is explicit absence only.
languageSecurityMapping.properties: Live owner-bound properties use direct access/assignment; getters and setters remain separate obligations. No raw XML constructor or dynamic arbitrary method dispatch.
languageSecurityMapping.collections: Zero-based numeric lookup, length and Symbol.iterator; negative lookup uses at only where supported, sparse placeholders retain keys, no blanket slice promise. Equality is explicit equals rather than JS wrapper identity.
languageSecurityMapping.numbers: Finite safe integer EMUs, unit conversion rounds halfway away from zero once; no coercion or unsafe arithmetic.
languageSecurityMapping.security: Async bytes admission/publication through explicit supplied capabilities. No implicit host paths, network, clock, fonts or native runtime.
languageSecurityMapping.errors: Neutral stable operation errors; pending model ValueError/TypeError/IndexError/KeyError/InvalidHandleError contracts are not replaced by a coverage claim.
